title: update_object
summary: MSUI now surfaces current Benilla's complete SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT movement block: LIVING/HAS_POSITION pose, six speeds, rider-local TransportPose, create-time CreateSpline with phantom-endpoint trim, and transport GameObject path progress paired with its local receipt clock. Streamed mid-walk units resume at the exact time_passed/duration fraction and retain id/flying/cyclic metadata. Rider poses persist through both create/movement blocks and later MSG_MOVE relays; transport-cycle and rider composition remain explicitly tracked as systems/transport work rather than decoder loss.

openItems.text: Create-time live spline (MOVEFLAG_SPLINE_ENABLED tail) is read and discarded - a creature already mid-walk when it streams into view stands frozen at its create pose until the next SMSG_MONSTER_MOVE (the exact bug Benilla decision 0708 fixed), and the spline id/time_passed/duration/flying/cyclic never reach the entity layer
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: MovementBlock exposes CreateSpline after dropping vmangos' phantom head and virtual tail. EntityStore resumes the existing CreatureSpline with its clock backdated by time_passed_ms, retains id/flying/cyclic metadata, and refuses zero-duration, degenerate, or completed paths. The focused synthetic wire fixture proves parse, trim, quarter-progress resume, continued motion and endpoint completion; focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: Rider TransportPose (MOVEFLAG_ON_TRANSPORT tail in the LIVING block) is discarded - an observed unit standing on a boat/zeppelin/elevator cannot be re-anchored through the transport frame
UPDATE_FLAG_TRANSPORT path-progress u32 is discarded - the transport GameObject cycle anchor (Benilla decision 0438) is unavailable to any elevator/ship evaluator
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: MovementBlock now exposes the full u64 transport GUID plus local xyz/orientation tail as TransportPose. EntityStore retains it on create/movement updates and refreshes it from observed MSG_MOVE relays. The synthetic two-object fixture proves tail alignment through all six following speeds and entity delivery.

openItems.text: Live-verify a creature first entering interest range while already walking: it should appear at its server-authored in-progress fraction, continue without freezing or the next MONSTER_MOVE horizontal snap, choose the correct ground/flying gait, and finish at the endpoint.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: MovementBlock exposes UPDATE_FLAG_TRANSPORT's u32 path-domain progress. WorldEntity retains it together with the monotonic receipt time needed to evaluate anchor+elapsed; the synthetic GameObject create fixture byte-pins 456789 and entity delivery.
